summary: Lilac Oaks: DROP CANDIDATE on Google 3.8 from 169 reviews (AWH 2026-11-02 rule), and the park is mostly long-term with park model homes sold. Rates confirmed $50 (Oct-May) / $70 (Jun-Sep) for 2026-27 with a standing 2-night minimum; now books online on Firefly (was phone); sewer corrected to false for the nightly sites; website moved to lilacoaks.com.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviews): Google Maps 3.8 stars from 169 reviews (read 2026-11-26) - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews is an automatic drop for a private park (AWH 2026-11-02). RV Life 4.5 / $$ stored.

LONG-STAY: mostly long-term. Online/nightly booking covers only campsites C1-C38 (RV AND tent sites); long-term spaces are numbered at least to 55 ('Long-term spaces 41, 42, 54 and 55'; 'Space 22 ... near Spaces 54 and 55'), leased on one-year leases ('One-year lease, $1,200 deposit'). Nightly share roughly 38 of ~93 (~40%), tent sites included - inside the 10-50% caveat band. Test 5: the operator (Anthem, 'a Manufactured Home & Park Model RV dealer') sells park model homes for the spaces ('Recently sold: Space 15 ... sold March 2026 for $114,000'; 'Stay a night, a week, or a lifetime.'). A resort selling homes: measured separately, the C1-C38 campground does sell nights.

PRICE GATE (private): $50 a night Oct-May (2026-2027 rates, 2 people, water/electric, before 8% tax and $3.50 booking fee) - at the line, not over it; $70 June-September. No Good Sam; gateway not needed.
MIN STAY: standing 2-night minimum on nightly RV stays, 3 on holiday weekends (recorded in booking.min_stay).
HOOKUPS: sewer true -> false (nightly sites 'no septic'; full hook-ups only in the long-term area). Stored electric 30 A not stated on the operator pages; left.
SITES: stored count 57 (note prose) is unsourced; the operator gives C1-C38 for nightly/weekly RV and tent sites, long-term spaces separately.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Three small ponds (each well under 5 acres); the operator mentions 'morning walks along the banks' but names no RV site on a pond, and the stored evidence found none fronting.
